name: Light Rain Baseline
description: Consistent light rain conditions with slightly increasing then decreasing wetness over a stint. Demonstrates wet-weather effects on tire grip and electrical harvesting.

provenance.notes: Phase 3 has replaced the Phase 1 placeholder with a dynamic weather timeline. PresetId preserved for backward compatibility with existing scenarios.

assumptionNotes.note: Weather timeline is a deterministic authored input, not a meteorological prediction. Wetness values represent a plausible light-rain stint profile.

values.notes: Consistent light rain with slightly increasing then decreasing wetness
